capabilities.why: Whether the portal mints the machine setup key itself with auto_groups DERIVED from the node-class (ADR 1116 §9), or only reports the derived groups for a human to assign. Earns a row because the default is restrictive (off = report-only): a goatnet that declares nothing inherits report-only silently, and hand-assigned keys quietly become its only enrollment path — the side door machine-mesh-alignment welds shut. The ZAGROS-on / zagros-prod-off window is a declared ADR 1120 skew, closed by the Phase-5 flag flip after the portal-image graduation.

Who the identity console's oauth2-proxy admits. Earns a row because it is a conscious per-goatnet decision with a user-visible consequence, not a service toggle: empty admits any authenticated member and lets adminGate do the enforcing, while a group list also blocks the self-service pages (/ssh-key, /operator-key) that exist for members with no admin rights. ZAGROS-PROD inherited the restrictive role default silently until 2026-08-10. Presence is separately enforced by ops/ci/check-console-door-declared.sh, because a single-member goatnet cannot skew against itself and so grades green while declaring nothing.

Intra-mesh PQC (ADR 0602). Named in design doc §5. The single per-goatnet knob that makes every enrollment surface hand new peers `--enable-rosenpass`; fleet default is false in group_vars/all.yml, so a goatnet that wants PQ WireGuard must say so on every node that enrolls peers.

Signed name-fallback snapshots (ADR 1082) — resolve mesh names when DNS is down. Named in design doc §5. Site opt-in with no fleet default, which is exactly the shape that goes missing on a second node.

F-261/F-262 boot-wedge watchdog + netbird service ordering. A federated node without it reboots into a wedge its peer self-heals from — the single clearest "one node re-rendered, its peer left behind" shape.
Identity-plane replication (ory_narrow repset). Cluster-shared Class-B by doctrine: the members of one goatnet share ONE identity plane, so this must agree across them or replication is asymmetric.
Fleet-visibility probe (Block 61). A cheap, whole-node capability that a new environment decides once.
Hosted-service health surface; also gates the generated per-site DNS zone Whether a node publishes service health is an environment decision, not a service default.
Environment-health `net` domain (ADR 1042). Which node holds the host-net vantage is a real per-goatnet choice, so it is rendered rather than assumed.
The per-host half of the same net domain — each node self-publishes its own link health. Unlike the rollup above, this is expected on every node that has a link worth reporting.

Whether this goatnet's obs node runs the Block 68C T1 → T2 image-mirror sync cron (ADR 0838). Graduated to a real environment decision on 2026-08-03 when the T1 endpoints were wired and the role gained a playbook slot; false everywhere until an operator flips it per site. The T1 ENDPOINTS themselves are deliberately NOT here — they are one cross-goatnet shared service in group_vars/all.yml, so comparing them across members would render permanent false agreement.

Whether the identity console authenticates the mint-capable onboarding leg with SPIFFE mTLS instead of the shared bearer fallback (runner-console-mtls.md). Earns a row because it is NOT a service toggle: it is a proxy for whether this goatnet HAS A SPIRE DEPLOYMENT AT ALL, and SPIRE has no boolean of its own to grade (zagros carries a whole group_vars/zagros_hosts/spire.yml; zagros_prod carries no such file). ADR 0412 is Accepted-DEFERRED and Phase A is zagros-only, so the split is real and long-lived — exactly the "something a new environment has to decide consciously" bar. Added 2026-08-17 after this divergence was found by reading a code comment rather than by any guard: the fact lived in four lines of prose beside the flag and in nothing the parity report reads. READ THE GRADING CAVEAT in docs/design/environment-parity.md §5 before trusting a green row here — `Node parity` compares members WITHIN one goatnet, so an zagros-true / zagros_prod-false split is rendered side by side but never graded SKEW.

The runner half of the same leg, and the reason this is two rows rather than one: the two flags must be flipped in ORDER (console first, then the runner, per the note at zagros_hosts/vars.yml:1952) so a half-flipped pair is a real state a reader needs to see, not a redundant duplicate of the row above. Same SPIRE dependency, same deviations.

node_shape.why: Which mgmt-stack profile the node runs (Block 22L.4 axis var).
Node serves signal + management + Traefik + Ory.
Node is a Spock multi-master peer (ADR 1084).
Node has a same-site streaming-replication peer.
Node carries its own pgBackRest durability rather than inheriting it via replication.
Node has a paired observability host.
Node minted the goatnet's account/policy rows vs joined an existing goatnet (ADR 1084). Explains most legitimate node asymmetry, so it is rendered first.

retired.why: Retired 2026-08-02 by WS4 of this arc. It gated the integdev-lab `roles/zenoh` (plain TCP, no mTLS, no ACL), whose 0.0.0.0:7447 publish collides with the live fabric router's mesh-IP bind. `site-bootstrap.yml` Phase 7D now fails closed on a surviving key. The design doc §5 names this flag as a report column; it is tracked here as an ABSENCE assertion instead, so retiring it did not silently drop it. Canon: docs/design/zenoh-data-fabric.md §"Which role deploys a goatnet's router".
